name: Floor Dip
summary: A bodyweight pressing movement performed seated on the ground that targets the triceps and anterior shoulders.

setup: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat, hip-width apart.
Place your palms on the floor slightly behind your hips, fingers pointing forward toward your feet.
Press into your hands and feet to lift your hips slightly off the floor, keeping your chest open and shoulders depressed.
steps: Inhale and bend your elbows straight back to lower your hips toward the floor.
Lower down until your elbows reach roughly a 90-degree angle without letting your shoulders roll forward or your hips touch down.
Exhale and press firmly through your palms to extend your elbows, returning to the starting elevated position.
instructions.breathing: Inhale as you lower down, and exhale forcefully as you press your arms straight.
cues: Keep chest proud and shoulders down.

common_faults.fault: Flaring the elbows outward during the descent.
common_faults.correction: Keep elbows tracking directly behind you in line with your wrists.

common_faults.fault: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears.
common_faults.correction: Actively depress your shoulder blades away from your ears throughout the set.

common_faults.fault: Moving the hips up and down using the legs instead of bending the arms.
common_faults.correction: Keep your lower body relatively still and isolate the movement to elbow flexion and extension.

precautions: Avoid excessive shoulder extension if you have active anterior shoulder pain or impingement.
